Pre-Foundation Course

The Pre-Foundation Course prepares students for undergraduate study at TEAM University, with a
focus on English and key transferable skills: critical thinking, group work and presentation skills.

Who is this programme for?

TEAM Pre-Foundation Course is a programme for those who wish to develop skills necessary for undergraduate studies at TEAM University.
The course mainly focuses on the development of students’ English skills and key transferrable skills such as critical thinking, group work and presentation skills. The course is subject to TEAM University quality assurance procedures. Students who will successfully complete the course will be automatically admitted to TEAM University undergraduate programme.

Accredited and officially recognised programme.

6 Months

Entry requirements

Completed 9 years of secondary education or equivalent

Grade 11 or Year 2 Lyceum student

Internal interview and assessment

English language level — B1 or equivalent

Age requirement: 16+

Required documents — education certificate, school confirmation letter, birth certificate

Learning Outcomes
01

Explain and support their viewpoint by providing evidence, giving reasons and evaluating different opinions both in written and oral forms.

02

Demonstrate an ability to communicate their message with a high level of lexical and grammatical accuracy and spontaneity on a number of familiar topics.

03

Produce and present their work in different formats with a high degree of clarity and detail.

04

Identify main ideas and details when reading and listening to complex input.

05

Demonstrate an ability to work in collaboration.

Progression

Successful completion gives admission to the next stage of study at TEAM University.

Progress to the Foundation or directly to the Bachelor’s programme
